shorts.title: The Worst Job in Old England: The Gong Farmer

hook.text: The worst job in old England? Emptying toilets. By hand. At night.

shorts.title: The King's Toilet Servant Who Became Powerful

hook.text: The most trusted man in Tudor England... worked in the king's toilet.

shorts.title: The Job Where You Had to Swallow a Toad

hook.text: His job was to swallow a toad. In front of a crowd.

shorts.title: The Man Paid to Eat a Dead Man's Sins

hook.text: Some people were paid to eat a dead man's sins.

shorts.title: The King's Men Who Could Dig Up Your Floor

hook.text: In 1627, the king's men could dig up your floor. And you couldn't say no.
hook.say: In sixteen twenty-seven, the king's men could dig up your floor. And you couldn't say no.

shorts.title: Why Workers Stomped on Cloth in Old Urine

hook.text: For centuries, new cloth was washed... in old urine.

shorts.title: The Smelliest Job in Medieval England

hook.text: This job smelled so bad, towns pushed it outside the walls.

shorts.title: The Medieval Job Where You Drank Ale for Work

hook.text: In medieval England, one man was chosen to drink ale for his job. So why did everyone hate him?
